note: Tencent Cloud Serverless Cloud Function (SCF) is a FaaS product inside Tencent Cloud, a business division of Tencent Holdings Limited, a large publicly listed Chinese conglomerate (HKEX: 0700, founded 1998, IPO June 2004). As a subsidiary product line, it has no independent funding, accelerator history, or standalone revenue disclosure; Tencent Holdings reports only consolidated/segment-level (FinTech and Business Services) revenue, not per-product figures for SCF. Buyers should treat this as backed by a large, financially stable public company rather than evaluate it on startup-style funding metrics.
